// diagnostic

E2401

The delegation target `{field}` doesn't implement `{trait}`, or the type has no field named `{field}`.

What

The delegation target `{field}` doesn't implement `{trait}`, or the type has no field named `{field}`.

Why

`impl Type.Trait using field` forwards every `Trait` method to the `field` field; if that field's type hasn't implemented `Trait`, there's nothing to forward to.

Fix

Implement `impl FieldType.Trait` on the field's type, or choose a different field that does implement `Trait`. If the field doesn't exist, add `{field}: FieldType` to the struct.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2401: tests/ui/delegation_no_impl.stderr.

Error [E2401]: `Inner` doesn't implement `Greeter`, so it can't delegate
  --> tests/ui/delegation_no_impl.jet:14:6
    |
 14 | impl Wrapper.Greeter using inner
    |      ^^^^^^^
 Why: `impl Wrapper.Greeter using inner` forwards `Greeter` methods to the `inner` field, but `Inner` doesn't implement `Greeter`
 Fix: implement `impl Inner: Greeter` on the field's type, or choose a different field
